rule: guaranteed = a continuous annual migration of 100,000 or more animals in a known season; likely = a documented annual migration or gathering of several hundred animals or more together in a known season (Sri Lanka's elephant gathering is the existing anchor); possible = herds of tens to a few hundred, seasonal, remote or hard to reach; unlikely = only small groups, or park totals too small for a mass gathering; notPresent = no herd-forming species.

zambia.evidence: Liuwa Plain: more than 45,000 wildebeest in Africa's second-largest wildebeest migration (African Parks, Oct-Dec); Kasanka: an estimated 8-10 million straw-coloured fruit bats, mid-Oct to late Dec (UNESCO tentative list).

botswana.evidence: About 30,000 zebra make the 250 km Chobe-Nxai Pan migration and stay at the pans December to February (CMS fact sheet on the Zambezi plains zebra; National Geographic, 2018).

zimbabwe.evidence: Hwange: more than 40,000 elephants in the dry season, visiting the waterholes every other day (CMS fact sheet on African elephant migration).

namibia.evidence: Etosha dry season: springbok herds often in the thousands, 200-300 zebra and 300-400 springbok at single waterholes (travel guides; no census herd data).

kruger.evidence: Kruger buffalo herds range from 1 to over 1,000 animals (PLOS ONE 2017, SANParks data); park-wide about 47,000 buffalo in 2016.

ethiopia.evidence: Gambella: part of the white-eared kob migration of about 5 million animals across South Sudan and Ethiopia (CMS fact sheet); most of it is in Boma, South Sudan, and Gambella is remote and hard to reach.

kaziranga.evidence: About 1,300-1,800 wild water buffalo, about 1,000-1,300 elephants and 800 swamp deer; herd sizes reported inconsistently (National Geographic; International Rhino Foundation).

rajasthan-golden-triangle.evidence: Tal Chhapar sanctuary (719 ha): about 2,025 blackbuck in the 2010-11 forest department census (Journal of Threatened Taxa).

pantanal.evidence: White-lipped peccaries travel in herds of 50 to 300 (Wildlife Conservation Society).

borneo.evidence: Bearded pig migrations of several hundred animals are known on fixed routes, but the Kinabatangan population fell by about 90% after African swine fever and the pigs are now rare there (Cardiff University; The Vibes).

ghana.evidence: Mole National Park elephant groups average about 9 animals, with herds up to 80 (2007 aerial survey, PMC).

rwanda.evidence: Akagera aerial census: about 2,100-2,600 buffalo and 1,000-1,800 zebra in the whole park, no mass gatherings recorded (African Parks).

leftBlank.nepal: Chitwan and Bardia chital herd sizes were not found on an official page.
leftBlank.uganda: Queen Elizabeth has about 90,000 Uganda kob (2018 census) but no herd sizes were found.
